title: Experience Model v6: CompilerGym two-system recipe-feasibility protocol v4
summary: Propose the hash-bound v4 architecture only. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are exactly the two on-policy systems; ORIENT and THINK_ACT are phases of one reconstructed model, not agents. They share capped read-only life snapshots in target forks; only EXPERIENTIAL mounts the cumulative life-local q/v LoRA rebuilt by the deterministic outcome-filtered, no-preservation writer. The exact packet, visibility, lifecycle, compiler, score, split, seed, and integrity-only Stage-C rules are owned by the two hash-bound v4 specifications. This proposal authorizes no inspection, installation, import, execution, model call, training, target opening, CPU/GPU run, or claim.
system_thesis: A bounded canonical packet and common nonparametric life evidence define both whole systems. The only adaptive parameter state is EXPERIENTIAL's deterministic acquisition-derived LoRA. The one-life, common-order assay can establish only whether the sealed recipe and its quarantined whole-system forks preserve their declared integrity; it cannot establish efficacy, causal credit, mechanism, lifetime growth, population behavior, functional correctness, or superiority.

nodes.before: v3 left packet, source-evidence fork mounts, and writer semantics materially underdefined.
nodes.after: HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are the only on-policy identities. Each uses the same pinned base/bootstrap/tokenizer, canonical packet, parser, retriever, public tools, locked acquisition order, budgets, ledger/notebook, and sleep accounting. HARNESS is null-adapter; EXPERIENTIAL alone mounts its authentic cumulative life-local rank-16 q_proj/v_proj LoRA below prompt assembly.
nodes.rationale: Preserves exactly two matched whole systems without turning ORIENT, THINK_ACT, SLEEP, or diagnostics into additional agents.

nodes.before: v3 could not execute a whole-system target contrast because its forks omitted life evidence and packet/visibility bytes.
nodes.after: Every ORIENT then THINK_ACT call is a fresh v4.packet reconstruction under context_visibility_spec.md. At checkpoints 0/4/8, each target fork mounts its own system's capped immutable target-blind ledger/notebook snapshot; EXPERIENTIAL authentic, off, and shuffled forks mount the exact same EXPERIENTIAL snapshot. Forks are cold, read-only, quarantined, and write back nowhere.
nodes.rationale: Makes D_HE a descriptive whole-system contrast while preventing target, arm, checkpoint, receipt, cache, or evaluation leakage.

nodes.before: v3 specified outcome-filtered learning but lacked fully executable compiler, packing, and optimizer bytes.
nodes.after: Only after acquisition tasks 4 and 8, the model-free compiler reads EXPERIENTIAL's sealed public acquisition projection and deterministically renders ORIENT/ACT/REVISE rows, deduplicates, selects, copies, packs, trains from the clean base, and atomically publishes one authentic adapter exactly as experiment_spec.md Sections 1 and 4 require. There are no anchor, preservation, KL, instruction, preference, auxiliary, negative, or non-acquisition rows/losses.
nodes.rationale: Closes writer discretion and keeps adapter-off a null-adapter diagnostic rather than a preservation-confounded comparison.

nodes.before: v3 deferred executable score, split, sealer, seeds, and Stage-C classification details.
nodes.after: The sole conditional substrate is unchanged already-local official CompilerGym 0.2.5 / LLVM 10 benchmark://poj104-v1. IrInstructionCountOz, I0/IOz denominator, six-decision G, four-group 8/4 static split and spare rules, B2 reset/baseline seal, SHA-256 seed domains, determinism tiers, and all indeterminate handling are exactly those in experiment_spec.md Sections 3, 6, and 7. Stage C emits only the first applicable integrity or descriptive feasibility disposition in Section 8.
nodes.rationale: Binds the benchmark and reporting contract before any later executable authority can be requested.

edges.before: v3 had unresolved context, prose, and authority choices.
edges.after: authoritative state -> ORIENT -> bounded own-snapshot retrieval -> THINK_ACT -> one typed operation -> public event; both phases use one model and all grammar, truncation, parser-charge, mask, and reader/writer rules are hash-bound to context_visibility_spec.md.
edges.rationale: Ensures only the defined reconstructed context crosses a model call.

edges.before: v3 did not fully bind compiler inputs and update execution.
edges.after: sealed EXPERIENTIAL public acquisition projection -> deterministic outcome-filtered compiler -> authentic adapter only; no HARNESS adapter, target/evaluation bytes, private/raw prose, optimizer state, or non-acquisition objective can enter.
edges.rationale: Restricts adaptive state to the specified public acquisition writer.

edges.before: v3 did not preserve common life evidence in primary evaluation forks.
edges.after: each sealed checkpoint -> cold HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL authentic fork with respective read-only snapshots; EXPERIENTIAL-only off at 0/4/8 and shuffled at 8 if the exact derangement succeeds; all outcomes remain in quarantine.
edges.rationale: Supports the declared descriptive contrast and diagnostics without creating a third on-policy system.

loops.before: v3 described a recurrent wake but left its packet grammar and persistence ambiguities.
loops.after: For each of at most six pairs, reconstruct the normative packet; call ORIENT on the pinned model; parse-or-charge; retrieve at most two own-snapshot records; reconstruct THINK_ACT; parse-or-charge one operation; dispatch, append, and charge exactly as context_visibility_spec.md Sections 2--4 specify. ORIENT and THINK_ACT are phases of one model; no provider history, cache, hidden prefix, or raw output persists.
loops.trigger: Each acquisition or target-fork decision until declared STOP, terminal state, or a hard budget/terminal failure.
writes: one parsed operational result or failure receipt
loops.stop_condition: The specification's STOP, terminal, budget, overflow, malformed, or terminal-integrity rules apply with no retry or cap change.
loops.rationale: Operationalizes the one-model context loop under exact visibility and lifecycle rules.

loops.before: v3 did not bind selection, packing, update, and destruction semantics sufficiently for a deterministic writer.
loops.after: After acquisition tasks 4 and 8 only, deterministically compile the sealed EXPERIENTIAL projection; select and pack rows; rebuild the authentic LoRA from the pinned clean base with fresh AdamW; verify receipts; atomically publish or stop; destroy gradients, optimizer, trainer, inference, cache, RNG, and temporary corpus state exactly under experiment_spec.md Sections 1, 4, and 7.
loops.trigger: Successful completion of common acquisition task 4 or 8.
loops.stop_condition: Any schema, visibility, packing, numerical, receipt, determinism, or integrity failure publishes nothing and terminates the recipe.
loops.rationale: Makes the writer deterministic and excludes preservation or concealed state.

claims.before: v3's intended feasibility report lacked fully exact specification bytes.
claims.after: Stage C may report only the integrity-based, first-applicable descriptive feasibility disposition and signed diagnostics defined in experiment_spec.md Section 8 for this one common-order life.
claims.evidence_needed: Passing scoped static, implementation, CPU semantic, and later separately authorized GPU/run-manifest gates with complete sealed receipts and quarantine audit.

claims.before: Any interpretation of score improvement or diagnostics as efficacy, causal credit, mechanism, lifetime growth, functional correctness, population behavior, or superiority.
claims.after: No such claim is authorized by this architecture change or any Stage-C disposition.
claims.evidence_needed: A separately deliberated, independently reviewed, and human-ratified change with appropriate new controls and lives.

acceptance_tests.setup: After scoped B1 implementation, run fixtures that verify both v4 spec hashes, declared-key serialization, exact ORIENT/THINK_ACT grammars, packet section order/caps/collision order, parser charges, and finite-only loss masks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every golden matches; malformed, overflow, unknown-key, over-cap, and prose-mask fixtures fail closed as specified.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the canonical one-model packet and mask contract was implemented exactly.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run local fixture graphs for all allowlisted principals and cold fork mounts at checkpoints 0/4/8, including H/E/off/shuffled snapshot identity and forbidden writeback attempts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only declared reads/writes succeed; each fork has the required read-only own-system snapshot, and target/evaluation/arm/receipt leakage is rejected.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the primary comparison is a whole-system snapshot contrast or that visibility is directional and closed.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run deterministic synthetic-ledger goldens covering improvement segments, REVISE construction, dedup ties, OLD/NEW scarcity, 24 copies, shuffle, next-fit packing, masks, and forbidden row/loss types.
acceptance_tests.expected: Selected rows, rejects, token masks, packs, update counts, and no-preservation assertion exactly match manifests; any mismatch stops publication.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the writer is deterministic, outcome-filtered, or free of preservation and auxiliary learning.

acceptance_tests.setup: After authorized B1/B2 work, run static fixtures and disposable unchanged-local CPU semantic traces for canonical split grouping, duplicate exclusion, spare substitution, B2 reset/baseline sealing, all score edge cases, and every SHA-256 seed domain/no-retry receipt.
acceptance_tests.expected: The fixed 8 acquisition/4 target split, score G and indeterminate outcomes, and derived seeds match golden receipts; any missing local byte, invalid baseline, duplicate, or failed spare rejects.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the CompilerGym score, split, B2 authority, or seed construction follows the exact v4 contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run B1 fixtures for sleep publication/destruction, HARNESS null-adapter accounting, life reset, fork cold start, quarantine teardown, and same-stack replay receipt comparison with a mock backend.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only authentic EXPERIENTIAL adapter bytes cross sleep; all forbidden process/cache/RNG/trainer state is absent; replay comparison obeys the declared tiers.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That lifecycle boundaries and adapter ownership are enforceable before GPU work.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run deterministic synthetic complete/indeterminate/integrity and diagnostic receipts through the Section-8 classifier without a model or target environment.
